All three VERIFY-HISTORICAL fixtures show exact equality between binding and decoded semantics CAS for those fields.

All 13 custody controls that substitute semantics/manifest equality edges refuse as expected.
trustRootRef is retained on the binding and in the six-object dependency set, not as a free adjacent override; substituting trustRootRef/publicKeyRef refuses.

requiredChecks.name: Actual executable custody
evidence: Each signed manifest maps every DELIVERY-supported platform to a CAS payloadRef with mediaType application/vnd.opensip.rust-native-executable and an entrypoint.
Recomputed full SHA-256 ContentRef from payload bytes equals payloadRef for every platform on all three manifests.
Payloads are not pure JSON: they carry native magics (e.g. ELF 7f454c46) and exact platform/target/ABI/entrypoint metadata.
Control VER4-CTRL-DESCRIPTOR-WITHOUT-PAYLOAD refuses historical-executable-incompatible when a JSON descriptor is substituted.
Contract and repair explicitly state fixture bytes establish custody/identity only; no product execution or demonstration claim.
